'''June 2001 Austin tournament (9 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Junior's, Austin, Texas on 9 June 2001. It is known from Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2426">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-09-austin-texas-6-9-01d2426/ austin-texas-6-9-01], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 9 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-09-austin-texas-6-9-01d2426/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Junior's, Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 27
* '''Winner:''' [[Jacob Mayer]]<ref name="tr-d2432" />

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Jacob Taylor Austin Texas 6-9-01 (tournament report)]] — by [[Jacob Taylor]], 7th, 3–3
* [[Jeremy Losee No Tag Austin 11 June 01 (tournament report)]] — by [[Jeremy Losee]], 5–1

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Jacob Taylor counts 27 participants and gives the winning Jacob a differential of +136; Jeremy Losee (d2432) counts 30 people and gives Jacob Mayer 'a difference of 156 or some crap like that'.<ref name="tr-d2426" />
* Jeremy Losee counts 30 people and gives Jacob Mayer about +156; Jacob Taylor (d2426) counts 27 participants and gives the winning Jacob +136.<ref name="tr-d2432" />
